evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Specifies a concrete technique (fingerprinting/content identification) and a clear outcome, enabling a reasonable implementation estimate.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Clear goal (profile-based search/recommendation); scope is definable for estimation (features, matching rules).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Specifies collaborative approach (similar users) which is concrete enough to plan and estimate.

evaluations.evidence: similar ... based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Defines the similarity-based outcome and target artifacts (music/video/ringback tones), so estimation is feasible.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Specifies data sources (metadata, tags) and desired outcomes (related artists, genres), allowing reasonable scoping and estimation.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded functionality: upload, persist tags, expose for processing — estimatable without design details.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Concrete UI/feature (thumbnail sequences for segments); scope is specific enough to estimate effort.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Although 'info' can vary, the feature of retrieving metadata for similar items is a definable, estimatable scope.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Defines perceptual similarity as the matching criterion and requests metadata/info, which is sufficiently specific for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Specifies recommendation source (similar profiles); implementable and estimatable as a discrete feature.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Gives concrete signal (news events in area) for recommendations; can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Functionality (person identification + related info lookup) is clear enough to make an implementation estimate, even if technical choices remain.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Concrete detection/lookup task with definable acceptance criteria; estimatable at story level.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection + metadata retrieval task; scope is bounded enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Clear detection and lookup objective; estimatable without requiring detailed design.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image ... recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Defines input actions and desired output (related video recommendations), which can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Specifies map-based discovery and notification about coverage — a discrete feature set that can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Defines the technology (ASR) and the user action (search), providing enough detail to estimate work.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin UI + edit/validation workflow are concrete functions and can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Specifies annotation plus topic extraction per segment; scope is defined enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Clear objective and signals (A/V quality) for filtering and ranking; reasonably estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Defines a detection outcome (edited vs not); while algorithmic, the scope is clear enough to estimate feasibility and effort.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Specific moderation/detection task with clear acceptance criteria; estimatable as a work item.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Specifies using low-level asset data for prefiltering; the approach narrows scope sufficiently to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Although legally sensitive, the functional goal (automated copyright validation) is a definable capability that can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Explicit data sources (metadata, tags) and prefiltering goal provide a clear, estimatable scope.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Terms are highly subjective and encompass multiple distinct assessments (interesting, appealing, complex) without acceptance criteria, making reasonable estimation infeasible.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Specifies inputs (annotations, Talk comments) and the outcome (prompt scientist); implementable rules can be defined to estimate effort.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer typology can be defined (features, clustering/classification) and scoped for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Specifies method (simple low-level features) and outcome (preclassification), so scope is concrete enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Clear detection goal with explicit acceptance condition (no classifiable animals), enabling reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Defines a specific detection scenario (timestamp malfunction) and desired capability, which can be scoped for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Task (species preclassification) is concrete and measurable, allowing estimation of implementation effort.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Specific preclassification of attributes is sufficiently bounded for planning and estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Detecting animal count is a focused, measurable capability that can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization is a clear technical task with definable scope and estimation possible.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Clear detection goal with explicit condition; task is bounded for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Explicit metrics (size, orientation) define the expected outputs and permit reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is a specific ML/processing task with estimatable scope.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Defines inputs and intended result (reduce duration by motion analysis); scoped enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection task with a clear outcome (timestamp), enabling estimation.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Lists concrete feature types to detect; while multi-faceted, each detection type is definable and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Specifies input (volunteer experience) and output (probability/weight), which is measurable and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Concrete artifact types are named and the prefiltering task is bounded for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Clear detection task with definable acceptance criteria; can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Defines a concrete audio-processing function (noise removal) with measurable outcomes enabling estimation.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping similar calls is a specific signal-processing task that can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Clear counting/detection task with a measurable output; estimatable at story level.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: 'Know when' is underspecified (no criteria/triggers), making reasonable implementation estimation impossible without further detail.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Lacks decision criteria and scope for determining interruption modality, so cannot be reasonably estimated as written.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: No acceptance criteria or triggers for 'when' to educate; scope is too vague to make a reliable estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Missing decision rules and criteria for modality selection; underspecified for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Open-ended ('which piece') without defined taxonomy or selection criteria, making estimation infeasible.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: 'Interesting' is subjective and no objective criteria are provided, so the story is underspecified for estimating implementation effort.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: No triggers, thresholds, or contextual rules are given for when the bot should comment, leaving scope too vague to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Undefined criteria for when an explanation is required; the lack of objective triggers prevents reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Very open-ended (content generation) without constraints or templates; scope is too broad and underspecified to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Grouping by similarity is a definable clustering/classification task with scoping options for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Specifies signal (previous experiences) and outcome (project recommendations); can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarization is a concrete functionality with definable outputs (article summaries), enabling reasonable estimation.
